cards.public_summary: Trey McBride caught a red-zone touchdown from Jacoby Brissett on an in-breaking route during drills.
cards.evidence:
McBride & Marv getting going in the red zone

[Responding to]: In red zone drills, #Packers give up a TD from Jacoby Brissett to Trey McBride on an in breaking route. Could not see coverage.

Then Marvin Harrison Jr. beats Keisean Nixon on a fade for TD. Looked like Nixon expected safety help that never came, and Harrison was wide open.
cards.commentary: The red-zone score is a positive practice signal for McBride's touchdown involvement, but one drill rep does not establish a season-long role or target share.
